title: Frankenstein, 1910, Edison Manufacturing Co., dir. J. Searle Dawley
contents: The creation scene: the monster forms in a burning vat (a burning dummy, filmed and run backwards).
license: US: PD (published 1910). Korea: PD (Dawley d. 1949; Edison d. 1931; Shelley d. 1851). Archive item marked PDM 1.0. This copy is tinted and carries new-looking intertitles, so it is probably derived from the Library of Congress restoration; a faithful restoration adds no new US copyright, but note it.
